question.text: A parallel plate capacitor with air between the plate has a capacitance of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>15</mn><mo> </mo><mi>pF</mi></math>. The separation between the plate becomes twice and the space between them is filled with a medium of dielectric constant <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>5</mn></math>. Then the capacitance becomes <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mn>4</mn></mfrac><mo> </mo><mi>pF</mi></math>. The value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is____.

solution.text:
Capacitance of the parallel plate capacitor when air is present between the plates, C=ε0Ad=15 pF

Capacitance of the parallel plate capacitor when dielectric is filled in between the plates,

 C'=kε0Ad'=3.5ε0A2d=3.52×15 pF=1054 pF

Therefore, x=105.
